verdict.rationale: Cake's own help centre documents a first-party Cake MCP server. It says users can connect Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client and query their live cap table in plain English, covering shareholders, option pool, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes. Missing for 10: setup, endpoint and authentication details in the evidence; write actions (access is read-only); independent or hands-on corroboration.
